_comment: Textures removed so modern Minecraft renders its own (correct) version. Cases, all verified against vanilla old-vs-new: (1) The horse was reworked in 1.11 - the 1.8.9 texture fills only ~28% of the UV the modern model reads -> mostly invisible horse, and (unlike the chest) the re-unwrap has no clean remap. (2) The creative-inventory tabs, whose art in the proving-ground pack is unfinished dev placeholders (red 'UN SEL' / blue 'SEL' boxes, ~94% transparent panels) - vanilla is the better outcome. Dropping yields correct, aligned vanilla versions. Remove an entry to keep the custom texture (at the cost of the mis-map). DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: anvil.png and enchanting_table.png were on this list until 2026-07-31, on the theory that their slot layout had drifted. Re-measurement disproved it - the 176x166 panel is 99.9% identical between 1.8.9 and modern, and the slicer's read boxes land exactly on 1.8.9's art - so dropping them discarded custom art for nothing. Do not re-add them; see docs/known-issues.md #4. (Chests are NOT dropped either - the chest stage remaps them, preserving custom art.) Paths relative to assets/minecraft/.
